detaileddescription.para: The Flash driver provides an API to configure the Flash module. Below are the high level features supported by the Flash driver.

listitem.para: Configure data cache, code cache, prefetch, and data preread for Flash Read Interface (FRI) 1-4

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Configure data cache, code cache, prefetch, and data preread for FRI1-FRI4

sect1.title: Important Usage Guidelines
sect1.para: It is important to look at your device's datasheet for information about what the required minimum flash wait state is for your selected SYSCLK frequency. See the Flash section of the TRM for more info.

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <flash.h>
